summary: 8/8 applicable boxes verified again in the same 4v4 match on the dev-host ioRTCW server (192.168.1.132:27963, mp_depot): the roster names Fleet110/123/124/133/143/171/184/240, every box has a sustained packet stream, and every fresh frame shows a spawned player. .186 and .243 are NA.
issues: The graceful close on .124 needed the force step: WolfMP.exe did not exit on WM_CLOSE within 12 s, so it was killed. Afterwards .124 was at its desktop at 1280x1024x32@85 with no crash dialog (ReturnToCastleWolfenstein_124_afterclose.png). The other 7 boxes closed gracefully. PROCLIST on all 8 shows no wolfmp/wolf/wolfsp process left.
